the study of the mechanism of action of the glucose 6-phosphatase system in the microsomal fraction of rat liver.
the elucidation of the role of bicarbonate ions in the regulation of the activity of microsomal glucose-6-phosphatase.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
bicarbonate ion inhibits all three catalytic activities of glucose 5-phosphate phosphohydrolyase, and that it does so by binding at the catalytically active site.

bicarbonate ion inhibits all three activities of glucose 5-phosphate phosphohydrolysis by a competitive type mechanism, and that the inhibition is probably due to binding to the catalytic active sites.

physiological concentrations of bicarbonate ions inhibit the activities of glucose-6-phosphate phosphatase and inorganic pyrophosphatase, and that the inhibition is due to binding of bicarbonate at the catalytic site of these enzymes.
